# OpenAI tunnel-client v0.0.15

The hosted VoxBridge image copies the `tunnel-client` object binary from the official multi-platform image `ghcr.io/openai/tunnel-client:v0.0.15` (pinned by OCI digest in the repository-root `Dockerfile`).

`LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this directory are copied verbatim from the official [`openai/tunnel-client` v0.0.15 tag](https://github.com/openai/tunnel-client/tree/v0.0.15) and are also installed in the container at `/usr/share/doc/openai-tunnel-client/`.
